q1: SELECT b1.name AS bar1, b2.name AS bar2 FROM bar AS b1, bar AS b2 WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT s1.beer FROM serves AS s1 WHERE s1.bar = b1.name AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM serves AS s2 WHERE s2.bar = b2.name AND s2.beer = s1.beer)) AND EXISTS(SELECT s2.beer FROM serves AS s2 WHERE s2.bar = b2.name AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM serves AS s1 WHERE s1.bar = b1.name AND s1.beer = s2.beer))
q2: SELECT s1.bar AS bar1, s2.bar AS bar2 FROM serves AS s1 JOIN serves AS s2 ON s1.beer = s2.beer AND s1.bar < s2.bar GROUP BY s1.bar, s2.bar HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s1.beer) = COUNT(s1.beer)

Q1 is checking for bars that serve a beer that no other bar serves, and Q2 is checking for pairs of bars that serve the same beer and the first bar in the pair serves more distinct beers than the second bar.
